Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Coran Jorun: 42-year-old woman, 183 cm (tall), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: wide triangular face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: one clipped color panel. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
